description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'Compare' that implements various comparison operations (like equals, greater than, less than, contains, etc.) used in the minilang framework of the ofbiz project. It includes different nested classes for each comparison type, a factory method to get comparison instances based on operators, and utility methods for comparison logic.

classes.name: Compare
classes.description: Abstract class representing comparison operations with multiple concrete implementations for specific comparison types.

classes.name: CompareContains
classes.description: Implements 'contains' comparison for collections and strings.

classes.name: CompareEquals
classes.description: Implements equality comparison, considering type conversions.

classes.name: CompareGreater
classes.description: Implements greater-than comparison with type conversion and comparison.

classes.name: CompareGreaterEquals
classes.description: Implements greater-than-or-equal comparison with type conversion.

classes.name: CompareIsEmpty
classes.description: Checks if the value is empty using ObjectType.isEmpty.

classes.name: CompareIsNotNull
classes.description: Checks if the value is not null.

classes.name: CompareIsNull
classes.description: Checks if the value is null.

classes.name: CompareLess
classes.description: Implements less-than comparison with type conversion.

classes.name: CompareLessEquals
classes.description: Implements less-than-or-equal comparison with type conversion.

classes.name: CompareNotEquals
classes.description: Implements inequality comparison with type conversion.

methods.name: assertValuesNotNull
methods.description: Ensures that given lValue and rValue are not null, throws exception if either is null.

methods.name: createInstanceMap
methods.description: Creates a map of operator strings to their corresponding Compare instances.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to retrieve a Compare instance based on the operator string.

methods.name: doCompare
methods.description: Abstract method implemented by subclasses to perform comparison logic.
